sentences.text: — Po. Kam një motër dhe një vëlla.
sentences.english: "Yes. I have a sister and a brother."
"Do you have a mother and a father?"
"Yes, I have a mother and a father."

sentences.text: — Jo, nuk janë këtu. Por unë jam mirë.
sentences.english: "No, they are not here. But I am well."
